settings.lede: We build trustworthy, privacy-preserving AI for connected systems: federated learning, edge intelligence, secure networks, quantum machine learning, causal AI and physical AI.
settings.mission: TrustNet.AI Lab studies how to make AI secure, private and dependable when it is trained and deployed across many devices, organizations and networks. Our work spans trustworthy federated learning, edge computing, post-quantum and blockchain security for vehicular networks, quantum machine learning, causal AI and physical AI.
settings.name: TrustNet.AI Lab

people.bio: Asadullah Tariq is a Postdoctoral Researcher at the College of Technological Innovation, Zayed University, and a Visiting Assistant Professor at Canadian University Dubai. He completed his PhD in Computing and Informatics at the United Arab Emirates University, where his research focused on frameworks for trustworthiness in federated learning. His work covers trustworthy AI, edge AI, wireless communication and quantum machine learning, and he reviews for leading journals including IEEE Communications Surveys and Tutorials.
people.name: Dr. Asadullah Tariq
people.title: Postdoctoral Researcher, Zayed University; Visiting Assistant Professor, Canadian University Dubai

people.name: Prof. Mohamed Adel Serhani
people.title: Professor, College of Computing and Informatics, University of Sharjah
people.bio: Mohamed Adel Serhani is a Professor at the College of Computing and Informatics, University of Sharjah, where he also serves as Deputy Director of the International Relations Office. Before joining Sharjah, he was Assistant Dean for Research and Graduate Studies at the College of Information Technology, United Arab Emirates University (2018 to 2022), where he also directed the PhD and Master's programs. His research covers federated learning, cloud computing for data-intensive e-health applications, SLA enforcement in cloud data centres, the big data value chain, cloud federation and monitoring, and non-invasive smart health.
education: PhD Computer Engineering, Concordia University, Canada, 2006
MSc Software Engineering, University of Montreal, Canada, 2002

people.name: Prof. Irfan-ud Din
people.title: Professor and Head of Department of Computer Science, New Uzbekistan University
people.bio: Irfan-ud Din is Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science at New Uzbekistan University in Tashkent. He previously served as Professor and Head of Computer Science at The Superior University Lahore, where he was also Director of ORIC (2021 to 2022), and as Associate Professor at INHA University in Tashkent (2015 to 2018). He held research and teaching posts at Incheon National University and Myongji University in South Korea, and was a postdoctoral researcher at KAIST. His research spans wireless communication, radio resource management, visible light communication and privacy-preserving federated learning.
education: Postdoctoral Research, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
MS Engineering, Myongji University, South Korea
BSc (Hons) Computer Systems Engineering, University of Engineering and Technology Peshawar, Pakistan
awards: Best Researcher Award, The Superior University Lahore, 2020 and 2021
Best Head of Department of the Year, The Superior University Lahore, 2021
Brain Korea 21 (BK21) Postdoctoral Fellowship, Korean Ministry of Education

people.name: Dr. Tariq Qayyum
people.title: Researcher, College of Information Technology, United Arab Emirates University
people.bio: Tariq Qayyum is a researcher at the College of Information Technology, United Arab Emirates University. His research covers federated learning, edge and fog computing, network security, cloud computing, the Internet of Things and distributed systems. His recent work includes decentralised hierarchical federated learning for privacy-aware fog computing, trustworthy split federated learning, quantum federated learning, and quantum-resilient blockchain for secure V2X networks.
education: PhD, College of Information Technology, United Arab Emirates University

people.name: Muhammad Ali
people.title: Lecturer, School of Computer and IT, Beaconhouse National University
people.bio: Muhammad Ali is a Lecturer at the School of Computer and Information Technology, Beaconhouse National University, Lahore, and a PhD scholar in Computer Science at the Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS). His research focuses on distributed systems, the Internet of Vehicles and edge computing, with work published in venues including the IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. He collaborates with the United Arab Emirates University on wireless communications and network systems research.
education: PhD Computer Science (in progress), Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)
MS Information Technology, National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST), Pakistan

people.name: Dr. Ikbal Taleb
people.title: Assistant Professor, College of Technological Innovation, Zayed University
people.bio: Ikbal Taleb is an Assistant Professor at the College of Technological Innovation, Zayed University, in Abu Dhabi. He holds a PhD in Information and Systems Engineering from Concordia University and an MSc in Software Engineering from the University of Montreal, Canada. His research covers big data quality assessment and analytics, data-driven health applications, misinformation detection, and trustworthy and quantum federated learning.
education: PhD Information and Systems Engineering, Concordia University, Canada
MSc Software Engineering, University of Montreal, Canada

people.name: Dr. Muhammad Waqas Haseeb
people.title: Postdoctoral Researcher, Lund University and United Arab Emirates University
people.bio: Muhammad Waqas Haseeb is a Postdoctoral Researcher at Lund University and the United Arab Emirates University. His research brings together quantum mechanics and machine learning, including physics-informed neural networks, quantum state diffusion and open quantum systems, and quantum machine learning. His recent work includes a study of vibration-assisted electron tunnelling in COVID-19 infection using quantum state diffusion, and co-authored papers on quantum federated learning and quantum-enhanced convolutional neural networks for image classification.

projects.description: Paste a reference list or drop in a paper. Each entry is checked against CrossRef, DBLP, Semantic Scholar, arXiv and OpenAlex. Retractions, duplicates and newer published versions are flagged, and mistakes come back as a corrected .bib file. Everything runs in the browser, so nothing is uploaded or stored.
projects.summary: A free citation checker that verifies references against five scholarly databases and flags retractions.
